tax.item: Why tax is negative (standalone ETR reconciliation, Note 36)
tax.value: Statutory rate 34.94% (old regime; tax on PBT 127.65) is fully offset by income-tax depreciation (-94.20), deductible/non-reversible items (-16.63), other items (-17.47) and MAT reversal/DTA on losses (+0.65) => 0% normal tax. Company pays MAT (64.00) on book profit but books an equal MAT credit asset (-64.00). Deferred tax is also a credit because the DTA recognised on tax losses (+323.60) exceeds the DTL on book-vs-tax depreciation (-269.60). Net: negative total tax, driven by heavy capex creating large tax depreciation/tax losses.
tax.note: Standalone PBT 365.34; FY25: tax-depreciation effect -121.58, MAT reversal/DTA on losses +37.48. Deferred tax movement from consolidated Note 6 (p205)

ratings.value: Delay in deleveraging: weak pricing through FY26 plus capex (INR 85-90 bn over FY20-FY26) doubled net debt to INR 38 bn (Sep-2025) while EBITDA barely grew; net leverage expected >3.0x in FY26-FY27, below 3.0x thereafter (12-15 months later than envisaged); FCF negative FY26-FY27, positive FY28
Outlook back to Stable if net leverage < 3.0x sustained; negative if net leverage likely to sustain > 3.0x

EBITDA margin ~14% in FY26, expected to improve in FY27; management guides consolidated EBITDA INR 18-22 bn by FY28; capex ~INR 11 bn FY26 and INR 6.5-8 bn FY27; scheduled repayments INR 3.2 bn FY26 and INR 3.2-3.8 bn FY27
Adequate: unencumbered cash INR 1.1 bn (Sep-2025); unutilised DP-backed WC lines ~INR 7.9 bn; average WC utilisation ~61% (12m to Nov-2025)
